name: eba-plataforma
description: EBA Cuac Cuac · Plataforma de evaluación del bienestar animal en patos y gansos (Metodología ICA v1.0, 2024)

scripts.dev: npm run build:norma && concurrently -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @eba/api" "npm start -w @eba/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:norma && npm run build -w @eba/web
scripts.test: npm run build:norma && npm test -w @eba/norma && npm test -w @eba/api && npm test -w @eba/web -- --watch=false
scripts.dev:red: npm run build:norma && concurrently -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @eba/api" "npm run start:red -w @eba/web"
